title: Polynomial presentation near a prime from local generators
statement: Let k be a field, P=k[x_1,...,x_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], I an ideal, S=P/I, q a prime of S, and p its inverse image in P. Suppose h:Fin e→P_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] generates I P_p. Then there is a∈S outside q such that for every b∈S, there exist e+1 polynomials in n+1 variables whose quotient is k-algebra isomorphic to S_(a*b) [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Regularity and dimension are not assumed or asserted.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC, (2) implies (1), clearing denominators and the polynomial presentation; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00SC

proof.text: The polynomial ring P over the field is Noetherian by Mathlib PrincipalIdealRing.isNoetherianRing and MvPolynomial.isNoetherianRing. Apply the common-multiplier theorem to I and p=q.comap(mk I), obtaining F_i in I and A outside p with A I contained in J=(F_i).

Set a=mk I A; it is outside q by the definition of p. For any b in P/I choose a lift B in P by quotient surjectivity. Since J is contained in I and A I is contained in J, the quotient-away-clearing theorem identifies (P/J) localized at mk J (A B) with (P/I) localized at a*b.
Apply the already proved inverse-variable presentation to the finite family F_i and polynomial A B. This presents the localization of P/J with Option(Fin n) variables and Option(Fin e) equations.

Use finSuccEquiv and MvPolynomial.renameEquiv to reindex Option(Fin n) by Fin(n+1), and precompose the relation family with finSuccEquiv e. Its range is the image of the old relation range under the polynomial equivalence, by surjectivity of finSuccEquiv e. Ideal.map_span and Ideal.quotientEquivAlg give the reindexed quotient equivalence. Compose its inverse with the presentation and the quotient-localization comparison.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (lemma-lci), proof of (2) implies (1), paragraph beginning with clearing the denominators d_i; source checked online and algebra.tex read in the sandbox scratchpad. General algebraic details expanded and proved directly in Lean by B3.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_principal_localization_presentation_of_local_generators
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
    (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)) (hq : q.IsPrime)
    (e : ℕ) (h : Fin e → Localization.AtPrime (q.comap
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
    (hgen : Ideal.map
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range h)) :
    ∃ a : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I), a ∉ q ∧
      ∀ b : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I),
        ∃ f : Fin (e + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k,
          Nonempty ((MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k ⧸
            Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ≃ₐ[k] Localization.Away (a * b))
